# Third-party components

## Settimino 2.0.0

**Author:** Davide Nardella. [Official project](https://sourceforge.net/projects/settimino/), [author profile](https://sourceforge.net/u/davenardella/profile/) and [licensing](https://settimino.sourceforge.net/licensing.html).

`Settimino/` preserves the five library files from the project's local `ESP32_WIFI` configuration. Source, comments, platform selection and original notices are unchanged. [settimino-source.json](settimino-source.json) records the configuration and SHA-256 hashes.

Git attributes disable line-ending conversion for this library so checkouts retain its exact bytes. Complete [LGPLv3](Settimino/licenses/LGPL-3.0.txt) and [GPLv3](Settimino/licenses/GPL-3.0.txt) texts are included, with their source URLs in `licenses/SOURCES.json`.

The source headers specify LGPL-3.0-or-later. The project MIT license does not apply to Settimino. Other dependencies are downloaded into `.build` with their distribution notices; see [all third-party notices](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
